TWO LANES · FREE AGENT-ONLY + PAID PUBLIC

Pick your lane

SonoWaves uses a two-lane payment model on BNB Chain: the free mint is Agent ID-only — one free wave per Agent ID, claimed through the Binance Agentic Wallet. Paid mints are public: anyone with an EVM wallet and BNB can mint, no Agent ID needed.

Free Lane — Agent ID Only

The first 2,260 waves are free — 1 free mint per Agent ID, claimed via mintFree() through the Binance Agentic Wallet. You only pay the tiny BNB gas. First come, first served, until the free pool is gone.

  • Mint #1 per wallet — FREE, Agent ID holders only
  • Free pool — 2,260 waves total
  • Binance Agentic Wallet + SPACE ID Agent ID required
  • Free mints earn no SONO bonus

Read the agent skill → · Go to the Priority Lane ↓

Paid Lane — 0.0007 BNB · Public

After your free mint — or once the free pool runs out — paid waves cost a flat 0.0007 BNB via mintPaid(). Paid minting is public: any EVM wallet can mint, no Agent ID required.

  • Paid pool — 4,406 waves
  • Flat 0.0007 BNB per wave
  • Bonus — 12,000 SONO per paid mint
  • Up to 10 paid per wallet
  • Max 11 per wallet total — 1 free + 10 paid

See the mint box ↓

FOUR TIERS · ONE FUSE LADDER

The tiers

Every wave starts as sound on water. Tier 1 is minted — the higher tiers are reached by fusing: burn 3 waves of one tier, receive 1 of the next. No luck, no gambling — the ladder is fixed and public.

Drop Tone
TIER 1 · COMMON
The single drop. Minted directly — free lane and paid lane both land here.
Ripple Chord
TIER 2 · RARE
Three ripples in harmony. Fuse 3 × Drop Tone → 1 × Ripple Chord.
Wave Harmony
TIER 3 · EPIC
Layered waves in full flow. Fuse 3 × Ripple Chord → 1 × Wave Harmony.
Tide Boom
TIER 4 · LEGENDARY
The tidal peak. Fuse 3 × Wave Harmony → 1 × Tide Boom. 27 base waves make one.

How the fuse ladder works

Burn 3 waves of the same tier and the contract mints you 1 wave of the next tier — deterministic, anyone holding waves can fuse, no randomness involved. Fused waves are new token IDs above the 6,666 mint supply.

3 × Drop Tone→1 × Ripple Chord→3 × that→1 × Wave Harmony→1 × Tide Boom
BONUS TOKEN · PAID MINTS ONLY

The SONO bonus

Every paid mint earns a bonus of 12,000 SONO — the collection's bonus token. Free mints earn no bonus. With at most 10 paid mints per wallet, the most one wallet can earn is 120,000 SONO.

FOUR STEPS

How it works

1

Get your Agent ID (for the free mint)

The free mint is Agent ID-only. Set up the Binance Agentic Wallet and register a SPACE ID Agent ID — that Agent ID is what mintFree() checks on-chain. No Agent ID? Skip to paid minting — paid is public for everyone.

2

Add BNB Smart Chain + fund BNB

In MetaMask, Rabby, or your wallet, add the network from the Network section below — Chain ID 56, symbol BNB. Gas on BNB Chain is paid in BNB; a small amount — 0.01–0.02 BNB — is plenty of headroom for minting, since BSC gas is very cheap. No bridging needed.

3

Mint your wave

Mint is live: Agent ID holders claim 1 free mint via the Binance Agentic Wallet (2,260-wave pool), and paid waves are public at a flat 0.0007 BNB — mint them right here with the button in the Mint section, or via the agent prompt. Each paid wave earns 12,000 SONO bonus, up to 11 per wallet in total. The artwork for your token is visible at mint — no delayed reveal.

4

Fuse up the ladder

Hold your waves, trade them, or fuse 3 → 1 to climb: Drop Tone → Ripple Chord → Wave Harmony → Tide Boom. Creator royalty is 5% on secondary sales.

Trade your waves

Also on Element Market

Element Market (element.market) is a third-party BNB marketplace — a second place to trade, alongside the SonoWaves marketplace above. The collection is live there now: search Element by the NFT contract address 0x8D8d7A02f7d02C6FbADc33e5Efd7cCaC7a2C8a6b or the SonoWaves name to find it, with floor price, owners, % listed, listings, and an Activity tab (Items / Offers / Activity) like other BNB collections.

Element reads the standard ERC-721 + ERC-2981 royalty (5%) already in the NFT contract — no extra contract was deployed for it. Element's own trading fees, if any, apply to buyers and sellers when they trade there.

QUESTIONS

FAQ

Which wallet do I need?

For paid mints: any EVM wallet on BNB Smart Chain — MetaMask, Rabby, Bitget Wallet, or Trust Wallet. For the free mint: the Binance Agentic Wallet with a registered SPACE ID Agent ID — the free lane is Agent ID-only.

How does the free mint work?

The free mint is Agent ID-only: 1 free wave per Agent ID, claimed via mintFree() through the Binance Agentic Wallet while the 2,260-wave free pool lasts. There is no direct free-mint button on this page: you claim it only by pasting the Priority Lane agent prompt in the Mint section into your Binance Agentic Wallet. Paid mints are public — anyone can mint at 0.0007 BNB via mintPaid(), no Agent ID needed.

What do I pay gas in?

BNB. SonoWaves runs on BNB Smart Chain (56), so every mint and trade pays gas in BNB. Paid mints cost a flat 0.0007 BNB each plus that small gas fee.

When did mint open?

Mint is live — it opened at 11:18 UTC, 10 Nov 2026. The NFT contract is 0x8D8d7A02f7d02C6FbADc33e5Efd7cCaC7a2C8a6b on BNB Smart Chain, and the counter at the top of this page reads the live minted total from it.

Where is the marketplace?

It is live. The SonoWaves escrow marketplace contract is deployed at 0xA9C1E5d2bDBac57C650CBE93a5B85350042cc9ba — see the Marketplace section. The collection is also on Element Market (element.market), searchable there by the NFT contract address / SonoWaves name. Only trust marketplace links that match the contract addresses on this page.

Is there a bonus token?

Yes — SONO. Every paid mint earns 12,000 SONO. Free mints earn no bonus, and with at most 10 paid mints per wallet the bonus caps at 120,000 SONO per wallet. There is no separate airdrop — SONO is earned by paid minting only. The token is deployed at 0x0D7f8dCEaDaC713F02AFCa86850F17f1f37f65BE.
